definition_zh: 必死性；死亡率；死亡
definition_en: the state of being certain to die, or the number of deaths in a group
core_image: 一排渐渐暗下去的灯：每盏都有自己的熄灭时刻，谁也留不住
scene: 婴儿的成活率提高了，人均寿命延长了，但医生仍说，人类终究无法摆脱最终的消亡。Even with better hospitals, the doctors could not promise to defeat mortality itself.
sceneCN: 这里 mortality 是「必死性」（第 1 个义项：人终将死去的属性）；句意：即便医院条件更好，医生也无法承诺战胜必死这一宿命。

derivatives.zh: 终有一死的；致命的
不死；不朽
发病率；病态

senses.title: The state of being mortal
senses.definition: the condition of being certain to die one day
senses.definitionCN: 人或其他生物终有一天必死这一状况
senses.example: Poems often reflect on the mortality of human life.
senses.exampleCN: 诗歌常常思索人生的必死性。
senses.why: The Latin suffix -itas turns the adjective mortal into the abstract state of being mortal.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语词尾 -itas 把形容词 mortal 转化成「必死」这一抽象状态。

senses.title: The rate of deaths
senses.definition: the number of deaths in a population over a period, expressed as a rate
senses.definitionCN: 一定时期内某人群中的死亡数量，通常以比率表示
senses.example: Infant mortality fell sharply after clean water reached the village.
senses.exampleCN: 清洁的水进入村庄后，婴儿死亡率大幅下降。
senses.why: Statistics turned the abstract state into a measurable number per thousand or per hundred thousand.
senses.whyCN: 统计学把抽象状态转化成每一千人或每十万人中可计算的数字。

senses.title: Death as an event
senses.definition: death, especially in a general or reported sense
senses.definitionCN: 死亡，尤指一般性或被记录的死亡
senses.example: The report links mortality among workers to long hours.
senses.exampleCN: 该报告把工人的死亡与长时间劳作联系起来。
senses.why: When the rate is spoken of in the plural or with a cause, the word names the deaths themselves.
senses.whyCN: 当说法涉及复数或原因时，这个词就指死亡本身。

intro.en: Mortality is a Latin loanword: mortalis, meaning subject to death, plus the abstract suffix -itas.
intro.cn: mortality 是一个拉丁语借词：mortalis（会死的）加抽象名词词尾 -itas。

items.en: A reconstructed root for death is commonly assumed behind Latin mors.
items.cn: 一般认为，拉丁语 mors 背后有一个表示「死」的原始印欧语词根（重构形式）。

items.en: Mortalis means subject to death, and mortalitas names that condition.
items.cn: mortalis 意为会死的，mortalitas 则指这一状况。

items.en: The Latin word passes through learned and later French forms such as mortalite.
items.cn: 这个词经由文言法语及后来的法语形式（如 mortalite）传播。

items.en: English mortality first means the state of being mortal and the plague deaths.
items.cn: 英语 mortality 最初既指必死状态，也指瘟疫造成的死亡。

items.en: Statistical use from the nineteenth century fixes the mortality rate sense.
items.cn: 十九世纪起的统计学用法固定了「死亡率」这一义项。

note.en: Mortality is the noun of death statistics as well as of death itself, so it stands close to rate words.
note.cn: mortality 既能指死亡本身，也是死亡统计的名词，因此与表示比率、数量的词相邻。

normalIntro.en: Mortality is the abstract noun built on mortal, and its relatives share the same death root.
normalIntro.cn: mortality 是由 mortal 构成的抽象名词，它的同族词共享同一个「死」词根。

normal.en: The -ity ending turns an adjective into a state, so mortal leads to mortality.
normal.cn: 词尾 -ity 把形容词变成状态名词，于是 mortal 变成 mortality。

normal.en: The prefix im- makes immortality, which is the direct opposite of mortality.
normal.cn: 前缀 im- 构成 immortality，正是 mortality 的反义。

normal.en: In public health news, mortality always comes with a rate or a figure.
normal.cn: 在公共卫生新闻里，mortality 总是和比率或数字一起出现。

normal.en: Compare mortality with morbidity: mortality counts deaths, morbidity counts illness.
normal.cn: mortality 与 morbidity 对比：前者数死，后者数病。

normal.en: A poet who meditates on mortality is often thinking of old age and loss.
normal.cn: 思考 mortality 的诗人往往想的是衰老与失去。

abstract.en: Picture a row of lamps dimming one by one.
abstract.cn: 想象一排灯依次变暗。

abstract.en: Think of a calendar with one red mark placed on an unknown day.
abstract.cn: 想象一本日历，其中一天被标了红，却不知是哪个日子。

abstract.en: Imagine a scoreboard where the number only goes up and never comes down.
abstract.cn: 想象一块计分板，数字只会往上加，从不往下减。

examples.en: Public health campaigns aim to cut childhood mortality.
examples.cn: 公共卫生运动的目标是降低儿童死亡率。

examples.en: The novel is a meditation on mortality, memory, and loss.
examples.cn: 这部小说是对必死、记忆与失去的沉思。

examples.en: Access to clean water reduced mortality in the region.
examples.cn: 获得清洁水源降低了该地区的死亡率。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「摩他来替」——总有那一天有人来替我们报出死亡的统计数字；这只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 mors（死，属格 mortis）+ -alis（形容词词尾）→ mortalis（会死的）+ -itas（抽象名词词尾）→ mortalitas → 英语 mortality，核心义「会死这一状态」。

sensesIntro.en: Mortality keeps the abstract state of being mortal, then narrows into a statistical rate of deaths, and finally names the deaths themselves.
sensesIntro.cn: mortality 先保留「必死」这一抽象状态，再收窄为统计上的死亡率，最后直接指死亡本身。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a row of lamps dimming one by one.
core.cn: 核心意象：一排灯依次变暗。

branches.en: The abstract state of being mortal is the oldest sense.
branches.cn: 必死的抽象状态是最早的义项。

branches.en: The measured rate is the statistical sense.
branches.cn: 可测量的比率是统计义项。

branches.en: The deaths themselves are the reported sense.
branches.cn: 被记录的死亡本身是报道义项。

branches.en: A mortality rate turns a fact of life into a number.
branches.cn: 死亡率把生命的必然转化成数字。

branches.en: Recorded deaths and their rates are usually reported together.
branches.cn: 被记录的死亡与其比率通常一起报道。

intro.en: Mortality is built from the Latin mort- root with the abstract suffix -ity and the negation im-.
intro.cn: mortality 由拉丁语 mort- 词根加上抽象词尾 -ity 构成，并用 im- 构成反义。

latinIntro.en: Latin mortalitas joins mortalis to -itas, meaning the condition of being subject to death.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 mortalitas 把 mortalis 与 -itas 结合，意为会死的状况。

items.exampleCN: mors 提供词根。

items.example: The suffix forms mortalis.
items.exampleCN: 这个词尾构成 mortalis。

items.example: The suffix forms mortality.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ity 构成 mortality。

items.example: Mortal is the base adjective.
items.exampleCN: mortal 是基础形容词。

items.example: The prefix forms immortality.
items.exampleCN: 前缀 im- 构成 immortality。

items.example: Immortality negates mortality.
items.exampleCN: immortality 是 mortality 的否定。

items.example: The suffix forms mortal from the root.
items.exampleCN: 这个词尾由词根构成 mortal。

items.example: Moribund shares the death root.
items.exampleCN: moribund 共享「死」词根。

items.example: The suffix forms morbidity.
items.exampleCN: 这个词尾构成 morbidity。

items.example: Morbidity is a companion term.
items.exampleCN: morbidity 是配套术语。

definition_zh: 砂浆；灰浆；臼；研钵；迫击炮
definition_en: a mixture of sand, cement, and water used to join bricks and stones, or a bowl in which something is crushed
core_image: 石臼：沉重石碗里，杵头把谷物一圈圈碾碎
scene: 工人在砌墙，用抹刀把灰浆抹在砖缝里，再压上下一块砖。The builders spread mortar between the bricks and pressed the wall level.
sceneCN: 这里 mortar 是「砂浆、灰浆」（第 1 个义项：砌墙时连接砖石的湿泥混合物）；句意：工人们把灰浆铺在砖缝之间，再把墙面压平。

pos.zh: 砂浆；灰浆；臼；研钵；迫击炮
用砂浆砌合；用砂浆涂抹

collocations.zh: 实体店铺（与网络店铺相对）

derivatives.zh: 由动词加名词后缀构成，指用灰浆砌筑的工艺
由动词过去分词转来的形容词，义为「用灰浆砌成的」
装填手；由 mortar 与 man 复合，指操作迫击炮的士兵

senses.title: A paste that holds bricks together
senses.definition: a soft mixture of sand, cement, lime, and water that hardens and joins bricks or stones
senses.definitionCN: 由砂、水泥、石灰和水调成的软质混合物，硬化后把砖石粘合在一起
senses.example: The trainee mixed mortar in a small tub beside the wall.
senses.exampleCN: 学徒在墙边的小桶里搅拌灰浆。
senses.why: The Latin mortar and mortarium name a basin where material is prepared, and the building paste is mixed and carried in just such a basin.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 mortar 与 mortarium 指准备材料的碗盆，砌墙用的灰浆正是在这样的盆里调制并运送，所以「盆」的名称转移到了「浆」上。

senses.title: The pounding vessel of a kitchen or lab
senses.definition: a hard bowl of stone, metal, or ceramic in which grain, spice, or mineral is crushed with a pestle
senses.definitionCN: 石头、金属或陶瓷制成的坚硬碗状容器，用杵在里面把谷物、香料或矿物捣碎
senses.example: She ground the peppercorns in a stone mortar.
senses.exampleCN: 她用石臼把胡椒粒磨碎。
senses.why: This is the word at its source: a thick-walled basin built for pounding, still used in kitchens and laboratories.
senses.whyCN: 这是这个词最初的意思：一只专为捣击而造的厚壁盆，至今仍用于厨房和实验室，核心意象直接来自这件器物。

senses.title: The cannon that lobs shells over walls
senses.definition: a short-barrelled weapon that fires shells at a steep upward angle over high obstacles
senses.definitionCN: 炮管短小的武器，以很陡的仰角把炮弹射过高大障碍物
senses.example: A mortar fired three rounds at the ridge.
senses.exampleCN: 一门迫击炮向山脊发射了三发炮弹。
senses.why: Military use developed from the wide, bowl-shaped cannon of early artillery, which recalled the shape of a pounding bowl.
senses.whyCN: 早期火炮中那种又宽又碗状的炮身让人想起捣物的石臼，军事用法便从这种形状类比中生长出来。

senses.title: To join or fill with mortar
senses.definition: to fix bricks or stones together with mortar, or to coat a surface with it
senses.definitionCN: 用灰浆把砖石砌在一起，或把灰浆涂在表面上
senses.example: They mortared the loose stones along the top of the wall.
senses.exampleCN: 他们把墙顶松动的石块用灰浆砌牢。
senses.why: Once the noun names the paste, the verb follows naturally to mean applying that paste to a structure.
senses.whyCN: 名词一旦指称这种浆料，动词义就自然而然地表示把这种浆料施用到建筑物上。

senses.title: Brick and mortar as a physical presence
senses.definition: a phrase describing a business that trades from real premises rather than only online
senses.definitionCN: 指在真实场所经营、而不只在网上交易的商家
senses.example: Small brick and mortar shops are reopening on the high street.
senses.exampleCN: 高街上的小实体店正在重新开张。
senses.why: The paste that makes buildings solid came to stand for the solid buildings themselves, especially when contrasted with online trade.
senses.whyCN: 让建筑坚固的灰浆转而来指代坚固的建筑本身，在与网店对照时这种转喻尤其常见。

intro.en: Mortar comes from Latin mortarium, a bowl for pounding, through Old French.
intro.cn: mortar 经由古法语来自拉丁语 mortarium（捣物用的盆），本义是「捣物的碗」。

items.en: Mortarium is a basin in which substances are crushed or mixed.
items.cn: mortarium 指用来捣碎或混合材料的盆。

items.en: The shorter form mortarium also names the plaster used in building.
items.cn: 同一词形的 mortarium 后来也指建筑中使用的灰浆。

items.en: Old French mortier carries both the vessel and the building paste.
items.cn: 古法语 mortier 同时携带「器皿」和「建筑灰浆」两义。

items.en: English mortier names a bowl for pounding and a mixture for building.
items.cn: 中古英语 mortier 既指捣物的碗，也指砌筑用的混合物。

items.en: Wide short cannon are called mortars because of their bowl-like shape.
items.cn: 口径宽、炮身短的火炮因其碗状外形而被称为 mortar。

items.en: The phrase brick and mortar spreads in reference to real shops.
items.cn: 短语 brick and mortar 流行开来，用来指真实的店铺。

note.en: Mortar sits in a family of Latin words about vessels and joining, and next to the concrete and stone terms of the building site.
note.cn: mortar 处在拉丁语「器皿与粘合」词族的中心，也与建筑工地上水泥、石材类词为邻。

entries.definition: a Roman basin used for pounding or mixing
entries.definitionCN: 古罗马用来捣碎或混合材料的盆

entries.definition: to humiliate or cause to feel ashamed
entries.definitionCN: 使羞辱、使难堪；只是拼写相近，词源不同

entries.definitionCN: 终将死亡的；只是拼写相近，词源不同

entries.definition: a powder that sets hard when mixed with water
entries.definitionCN: 与水混合后会变硬的粉末，是砂浆的主要成分

entries.definition: a hard building material of cement, sand, and gravel
entries.definitionCN: 由水泥、砂和石子制成的坚硬建筑材料

entries.definition: the club-shaped tool used with a mortar
entries.definitionCN: 与臼配套使用的杵

normalIntro.en: Mortar is a bowl-word that spread to the paste made in it, and then to the building and the gun built like a bowl.
normalIntro.cn: mortar 本是「碗」的词，后来转到碗里调出的浆料，再转到用这种浆料砌的建筑和形状像碗的炮。

normal.en: Brick and mortar means the real shop, not the website.
normal.cn: brick and mortar 指真实店铺，而不是网站。

normal.en: Mortar and pestle are a pair; the bowl never travels alone.
normal.cn: mortar and pestle 是一对：碗从不独自出现。

normal.en: The mort- spelling here has nothing to do with mort-, meaning death.
normal.cn: 这里的 mort- 拼写与表示「死亡」的 mort- 无关，不要混记。

normal.en: To mortar a wall is to work the paste into the joints.
normal.cn: to mortar a wall 就是把浆料填进砖缝里。

normal.en: A mortar in the army is a short wide tube, a bowl turned upward.
normal.cn: 军用的 mortar 是短而宽的炮管，像一只朝天翻过来的碗。

abstract.en: See a heavy stone bowl with a wooden club striking down into it.
abstract.cn: 想象一只厚重石碗，一根木杵从上方砸进碗里。

abstract.en: Picture a striped can of paste and a trowel scraping it along a brick.
abstract.cn: 想象一罐带条纹的浆料和一把抹刀，在砖面上一刮而过。

abstract.en: Imagine a shell rising steeply, then falling behind a high wall.
abstract.cn: 想象炮弹陡直升起，然后落到高墙后面。

examples.en: The old wall was built with lime mortar and river stones.
examples.cn: 这堵老墙是用石灰砂浆和河石砌成的。

examples.en: He crushed the herbs with a mortar and pestle.
examples.cn: 他用臼和杵把香草捣碎。

examples.en: Bookshops with brick and mortar stores still attract loyal readers.
examples.cn: 有实体店面的书店仍然吸引着忠实读者。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「磨透」——石碗被杵磨到透亮，就是臼、研钵；这只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 mortarium（捣物用的盆）→ 古法语 mortier → 英语 mortar；核心义「捣物与调浆的碗」，由器物转指浆料，再转指用浆砌成的建筑与碗状火炮。

sensesIntro.en: Mortar starts as a pounding bowl, then names the paste mixed in such a bowl, then the mortar-built building and the bowl-shaped gun, and finally the verb of applying the paste.
sensesIntro.cn: mortar 先指捣物的石碗，再指在此类碗中调成的浆料，随后指用浆砌成的建筑与碗状火炮，最后由名词长出「抹浆砌筑」的动词义。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a heavy stone bowl struck from above by a club.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只厚重石碗，被杵从上往下砸。

branches.en: The paste mixed in a basin is the main everyday sense today.
branches.cn: 在盆里调出的浆料是今天最主要的日常义项。

branches.en: The original basin itself survives in kitchens and labs.
branches.cn: 最初的盆状器物在厨房和实验室里保存下来。

branches.en: A stumpy bowl-shaped cannon is the military branch of the image.
branches.cn: 矮而碗形的火炮是这一意象在军事上的分支。

branches.en: The verb simply applies the paste to a structure.
branches.cn: 动词义只是把浆料用到建筑物上。

branches.en: The paste stands for the solid building, as in brick and mortar.
branches.cn: 浆料转喻坚固的建筑，即 brick and mortar 中的用法。

intro.en: Mortar is a whole Latin word rather than a prefix-plus-root build, but the mortar family grows readily with -ing, -ed, and compound partners.
intro.cn: mortar 是完整的拉丁词，并非由前缀加词根拼成，但其词族可以借助 -ing、-ed 和复合搭配自由扩展。

latinIntro.en: Latin mortarium means a vessel for pounding, and the word has no separable prefix in English.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 mortarium 意为捣物用的容器，在英语中它没有可以拆出的前缀。

items.exampleCN: mortarium 是这个词的直接来源。

items.example: Mortar hardens between the bricks.
items.exampleCN: mortar 在砖块之间变硬。

items.example: A mortar holds spices while they are ground.
items.exampleCN: 研钵在研磨时盛放香料。

items.example: Workers mortared the stones in place.
items.exampleCN: 工人们用浆料把石块砌到位。

items.exampleCN: 抹刀沿砖面把灰浆摊开。

items.example: A mortarboard looks like an upturned square tray.
items.exampleCN: 学位帽看起来像一只翻过来的方盘。

items.example: The phrase sets a real shop against a website.
items.exampleCN: 这个短语把真实店铺与网站相对照。

definition_zh: 清真寺；礼拜寺
definition_en: a building where Muslims go to worship, pray, and meet
core_image: 圆顶与宣礼塔：信徒弯腰叩首，俯首跪下之处
scene: 黄昏时分，清真寺的宣礼塔上传来呼唤，街坊纷纷放下手里的活，朝同一个方向走去。At dusk the call from the mosque drew the whole neighbourhood to prayer.
sceneCN: 这里 mosque 是「清真寺、礼拜寺」（第 1 个义项：穆斯林礼拜与聚会的建筑）；句意：黄昏时分，清真寺传来的呼唤把整个街区的人都引向礼拜。

derivatives.zh: 由阿拉伯语同源词形译入英语，义为「清真寺」，常用于专名
由 mosque 加形容词后缀 -like 构成，义为「像清真寺的」

senses.title: A building for Muslim worship
senses.definition: a building where Muslims gather for ritual prayer and religious teaching
senses.definitionCN: 穆斯林聚集进行礼拜和宗教学习的建筑
senses.example: The mosque in the old quarter opens before sunrise.
senses.exampleCN: 老城区的那座清真寺在日出前就开门了。
senses.why: The Arabic root means to bow down in worship, so the building is named after the act of prostration it shelters.
senses.whyCN: 阿拉伯语词根意为「俯身礼拜」，所以这座建筑是由它庇护的叩拜动作来命名的。

senses.title: The whole place of prostration
senses.definition: the sacred area, often with a courtyard and fountain, where prostrate prayer takes place
senses.definitionCN: 常带庭院与水池的礼拜区域，特指进行叩拜礼拜的场所
senses.example: Shoes are left at the door before anyone steps into the mosque.
senses.exampleCN: 进清真寺之前，大家会在门口脱鞋。
senses.why: The word names the place set apart for prayer, so the sense covers the courtyard and washing area, not just the prayer hall.
senses.whyCN: 这个词指为礼拜而单独划出的场所，所以这一义项涵盖庭院与净身之处，而不只是礼拜大殿。

senses.title: The community that gathers there
senses.definition: by extension, the congregation and the local Muslim community centred on the building
senses.definitionCN: 引申指以这座建筑为中心的会众与当地穆斯林群体
senses.example: The mosque organised food parcels for families in need.
senses.exampleCN: 清真寺的社群为困难家庭组织了食物包裹。
senses.why: A building that gathers people weekly for prayer also gathers them for charity and news, so the building name transfers to its people.
senses.whyCN: 一座每周把人聚起来礼拜的建筑，也把人聚起来做慈善、通消息，于是建筑之名自然转指其中的人。

senses.title: The architecture of dome and minaret
senses.definition: a style of building marked by a dome, arches, and a tall tower that carries the call to prayer
senses.definitionCN: 以圆顶、拱廊和传递召唤的高塔为特征的建筑样式
senses.example: The skyline is a line of mosque domes against the hills.
senses.exampleCN: 天际线是一排映着山影的清真寺圆顶。
senses.why: Because the building type is so recognisable, the word also names the architectural form itself.
senses.whyCN: 这种建筑类型极易辨认，所以这个词也用来指建筑风格本身。

intro.en: Mosque comes from Arabic masjid, a place of prostration, through Spanish and French.
intro.cn: mosque 来自阿拉伯语 masjid（叩拜之处），经由西班牙语和法语进入英语。

items.en: Masjid means a place where one prostrates in worship.
items.cn: masjid 意为礼拜时俯身叩首的地方。

items.en: In the speech of Iberia the word was said as masgid.
items.cn: 在伊比利亚半岛的阿拉伯语口语中，这个词读作 masgid。

items.en: Spanish mezquita drops the middle sound and shifts the vowels.
items.cn: 西班牙语 mezquita 丢掉中间的辅音并改变了元音。

items.en: Old French mosquee takes the form a step further toward the modern word.
items.cn: 古法语 mosquee 把词形再朝今天的写法推进了一步。

items.en: English mosque settles into the spelling still used today.
items.cn: 英语 mosque 在十六世纪定型为今天仍在使用的拼写。

items.en: Writers begin to borrow the Arabic-derived masjid for proper names.
items.cn: 现代英语作家开始借用阿拉伯语词形 masjid 作专名。

note.en: Mosque is a borrowing of one Arabic root, close in form to masjid and in meaning to the other sacred buildings beside it.
note.cn: mosque 是阿拉伯语词根的借词，词形上接近 masjid，意义上与周边的其他宗教建筑为邻。

entries.definition: the original Arabic word for a place of prayer
entries.definitionCN: 阿拉伯语中表示礼拜场所的原词，与 mosque 同源

entries.definition: the Spanish form of the word
entries.definitionCN: 西班牙语中的对应词形，是 mosque 的中转来源之一

entries.definition: a small biting flying insect
entries.definitionCN: 一种会叮咬的小飞虫；只是拼写相近，词源不同

entries.definition: a building for Christian worship
entries.definitionCN: 基督教礼拜建筑

entries.definition: a building for Jewish worship
entries.definitionCN: 犹太教礼拜建筑

entries.definition: a building used for worship in many faiths
entries.definitionCN: 许多宗教通用的庙宇建筑

normalIntro.en: Mosque is a loanword from Arabic, so remember it as a whole picture rather than as parts to decode.
normalIntro.cn: mosque 是从阿拉伯语借来的词，所以要把它记成一幅完整的画面，而不是可以拆解的部件。

normal.en: Compare masjid: the two words share one Arabic root.
normal.cn: 对比 masjid：两个词共享同一个阿拉伯语词根。

normal.en: Remember the -que ending, the same spelling pattern as unique.
normal.cn: 记住词尾 -que，与 unique 的拼写模式相同。

normal.en: A mosque is not a musque or a masque; keep the o and the q together.
normal.cn: mosque 不要写成 musque 或 masque，要保留 o 和 q 连在一起。

normal.en: Go to the mosque is the plain collocation for attending prayer.
normal.cn: go to the mosque 是表示去礼拜的最朴素搭配。

normal.en: Minaret, dome, and courtyard are the three features a mosque is recognised by.
normal.cn: 宣礼塔、圆顶与庭院是辨认清真寺的三个特征。

abstract.en: See a row of bodies bowing low in unison, foreheads on the floor.
abstract.cn: 想象一排身体整齐地俯下，额头触地。

abstract.en: Picture a pale dome and a slender tower cutting the evening sky.
abstract.cn: 想象一枚浅色圆顶和一座细塔切开傍晚的天空。

abstract.en: Imagine a courtyard fountain where dozens of people wash before prayer.
abstract.cn: 想象庭院里的水池，许多人礼拜前在那里净手。

examples.en: The new mosque was designed with a wide courtyard.
examples.cn: 新清真寺设计了一个宽阔的庭院。

examples.en: Hundreds of worshippers filled the mosque on the first night.
examples.cn: 首个夜晚，数百名礼拜者挤满了清真寺。

examples.en: The mosque also runs a small school for children.
examples.cn: 这座清真寺还开办了一所小型儿童学校。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「莫斯克」——把 mosque 念成「莫斯克」，联想到圆顶与宣礼塔；这只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 阿拉伯语 masjid（叩拜之处），经伊比利亚阿拉伯语与西班牙语 mezquita、古法语 mosquee 进入英语；核心义「俯身礼拜的地方」。

sensesIntro.en: Mosque begins as the building of prostration, spreads to the whole sacred place, then to the community it gathers, and finally to its unmistakable architecture.
sensesIntro.cn: mosque 先指叩拜用的建筑，扩展到整个礼拜场所，再由场所转指聚集其中的社群，最后指这种建筑样式本身。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a worshipper bending low, forehead touching the floor.
core.cn: 核心意象：礼拜者俯身，额头触地。

branches.en: The building for worship is the primary sense.
branches.cn: 用于礼拜的建筑是核心义项。

branches.en: The sacred place as a whole includes court and fountain.
branches.cn: 作为整体的圣所还包括庭院和净身处。

branches.en: The congregation stands for the community around the building.
branches.cn: 会众转指以这座建筑为中心的社群。

branches.en: Dome and minaret turn the word into an architectural style.
branches.cn: 圆顶与宣礼塔把词义变成一种建筑样式。

branches.en: Because people gather there weekly, building and community keep overlapping.
branches.cn: 由于人们每周在此聚集，建筑与社群两层含义持续交织。

intro.en: Mosque is a loanword with no separable English prefix, and its family grows mostly through compounds and the -like suffix.
intro.cn: mosque 是借词，没有可拆分的英语前缀，它的词族主要通过复合词和后缀 -like 扩展。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin word behind mosque; it reached English through Spanish and French from Arabic.
latinIntro.cn: mosque 背后没有拉丁语词，它是从阿拉伯语经西班牙语和法语传入英语的。

items.example: Masjid is the direct source of mosque.
items.exampleCN: masjid 是 mosque 的直接来源。

items.example: The Iberian form masgid was heard in the south of Spain.
items.exampleCN: 伊比利亚地区的 masgid 形曾在西班牙南部使用。

items.example: Mezquita is a Spanish bridge to the English word.
items.exampleCN: mezquita 是通向英语词形的西班牙语中转站。

items.example: Mosque entered English in the sixteenth century.
items.exampleCN: mosque 于十六世纪进入英语。

items.example: The suffix -like forms mosquelike.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -like 构成 mosquelike。

items.meaning: the tower for the call to prayer
items.example: A minaret rises beside the dome.
items.exampleCN: 宣礼塔在圆顶旁耸起。

items.meaning: the person who makes the call
items.example: The muezzin calls from the minaret.
items.exampleCN: 宣礼员在塔上发出召唤。

items.meaning: the open court of a mosque
items.example: Trees shade the mosque courtyard.
items.exampleCN: 树木为清真寺庭院遮荫。

items.meaning: the rounded roof of a mosque
items.example: The mosque dome shines after rain.
items.exampleCN: 雨后清真寺的圆顶发亮。

definition_zh: 苔藓；青苔；藓类植物
definition_en: a small green plant without flowers that grows in damp shade in dense soft patches on rocks, trees, or soil
core_image: 石头上的一层绿绒：潮湿背阴处，绿色小垫子悄悄铺开
scene: 一场雨过后，林间老树根上的青苔吸饱了水，踩上去又软又滑。After the rain the moss on the old roots felt soft and cool underfoot.
sceneCN: 这里 moss 是「苔藓、青苔」（第 1 个义项：潮湿背阴处成片生长的绿色无花小植物）；句意：雨后老树根上的青苔踩在脚下又软又凉。

derivatives.zh: 由 moss 加形容词后缀 -y 构成，义为「长满苔藓的」
mossy 的比较级，义为「更覆满苔藓的」
moss 的复数形式，也常指苔藓各物种的统称

senses.title: A green carpet plant of damp shade
senses.definition: a low nonflowering plant that forms soft green cushions on damp rock, bark, or ground
senses.definitionCN: 一种低矮的不开花植物，在潮湿的岩石、树皮或地面上形成柔软的绿色垫层
senses.example: Thick moss covers the north side of the wall.
senses.exampleCN: 墙的北侧长满厚厚的苔藓。
senses.why: The Old English word names what grows in a bog, so the plant is identified by the wet place where it thrives.
senses.whyCN: 古英语原词指的是沼地里长出来的东西，这种植物正是以它生长的潮湿之地来被辨识的。

senses.title: The patch itself as ground cover
senses.definition: a whole bed of such plants seen as one soft green layer over a surface
senses.definitionCN: 成片的这类植物，被看作覆盖在表面的一层柔软绿毯
senses.example: The path was soft with cool moss.
senses.exampleCN: 小路因为凉爽的苔藓层而变得柔软。
senses.why: Since the plants grow in dense mats rather than single stems, the word naturally names the mat rather than one plant.
senses.whyCN: 这些植物以密集的垫状而不是单株生长，所以这个词自然指称整张垫层，而非一株植物。

senses.title: Any member of the moss group
senses.definition: in botany, a plant of the group called byrologists mosses, as opposed to lichens or liverworts
senses.definitionCN: 植物学上指苔藓学者所称的藓类植物，与地衣、苔类相区别。
senses.example: Students collected ten species of moss in the wetland.
senses.exampleCN: 学生们在湿地采集了十种藓类植物。
senses.why: Science uses the everyday word for a whole class of plants, once similarity in look replaced exact kinship.
senses.whyCN: 科学界用这个日常词来指称整整一类植物，因为外形相似逐渐取代了严格的亲缘关系。

senses.title: To cover with moss
senses.definition: to spread moss over something, or for a surface to become overgrown with it
senses.definitionCN: 把苔藓铺在物体上，或指某个表面长满苔藓
senses.example: Gardeners moss the stones around the pond edge.
senses.exampleCN: 园丁在池塘边的石头上铺苔。
senses.why: The verb simply turns the plant name into an action of laying it or of letting it claim a surface.
senses.whyCN: 动词义只是把植物名词转化为「铺上它」或「任它覆盖」的动作。

intro.en: Moss is an old English word for bog growth, related to the marsh words that also underlie mire.
intro.cn: moss 是英语古词，本指沼泽里的生长物，与构成 mire 的沼泽类词同源。

items.en: The reconstructed base maihsa means bog or marsh.
items.cn: 重构词根 maihsa 意为沼泽、泥沼。

items.en: Mos names both the plant and the boggy ground it grows on.
items.cn: 古英语 mos 同时指这种植物和它生长的泥沼地。

items.en: The plant sense grows stronger while the bog sense fades.
items.cn: 植物义的比重增强，沼泽义逐渐淡出。

items.en: The adjective mossy and the verb of covering are in regular use.
items.cn: 形容词 mossy 与「铺苔」的动词用法已成常例。

items.en: Botanists fix mosses as the name of a whole plant group.
items.cn: 十八世纪植物学家把 mosses 定为一大类植物的名称。

items.en: Moss now mainly means the soft green plant of damp shade.
items.cn: 现代英语中 moss 主要指潮湿阴处的绿色柔软植物。

note.en: Moss belongs to a marsh-rooted family and sits near the other low plants of a wet forest floor.
note.cn: moss 属于一个源自沼泽的词族，身边是湿地林下层中其他低矮植物。

entries.definition: covered with moss
entries.definitionCN: 长满苔藓的，由 moss 加 -y 构成

entries.definition: more covered with moss
entries.definitionCN: mossy 的比较级，覆苔更多的

entries.definition: the plural and the group name in botany
entries.definitionCN: 复数形式，也是植物学上的类群名称

entries.definition: a slow-growing growth of fungus and alga on stone or bark
entries.definitionCN: 真菌与藻类共生、缓慢生长于岩石或树皮上的生物

entries.definition: a small plant that grows in damp places like moss
entries.definitionCN: 与苔藓一样生长在阴湿处的小型植物

entries.definition: a green plant with feathery fronds but no flowers
entries.definitionCN: 有羽状叶、不开花的绿色植物

normalIntro.en: Moss is a short old word for what grows in wet ground, and the whole family hangs on three added letters.
normalIntro.cn: moss 是古老的短词，指在潮湿之地生长之物，整个词族都靠加上几个字母扩展。

normal.en: Add -y and you get mossy, the everyday adjective for anything green and soft on stone.
normal.cn: 加上 -y 就是 mossy，用来形容石头上任何变绿变软的东西。

normal.en: The plural mosses also names the whole plant group in botany.
normal.cn: 复数 mosses 在植物学上也指这一类植物的总称。

normal.en: Sphagnum moss is the peat-forming moss of every bog.
normal.cn: sphagnum moss 就是每片沼泽里造出泥炭的那种藓。

normal.en: Moss shares its root family with mire, and both point at wet ground.
normal.cn: moss 与 mire 同属一个词族，两者都指向潮湿的地面。

normal.en: A moss never flowers; it spreads by spores and grows in shade.
normal.cn: 苔藓从不开花，靠孢子繁殖，并且长在阴处。

abstract.en: Run a finger over a granite boulder and feel the velvet green.
abstract.cn: 用手指拂过花岗岩巨石，感受那层丝绒般的绿。

abstract.en: Picture a mat of water held in a sponge of tiny leaves.
abstract.cn: 想象一张把水蓄在细小叶片里的活海绵垫。

abstract.en: See the shaded side of every wall in a forest going green with age.
abstract.cn: 想象林中每堵墙的背阴面随着年岁一点点变绿。

examples.en: A thin layer of moss keeps the soil cool and moist.
examples.cn: 薄薄一层苔藓让土壤保持凉爽湿润。

examples.en: They gathered sphagnum moss to line the seed boxes.
examples.cn: 他们采集泥炭藓来垫育苗箱。

examples.en: The old stone steps are mossy and slippery after rain.
examples.cn: 古老的石阶长满青苔，雨后十分湿滑。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「毛丝」——青苔像一层柔软的毛丝铺在石头上；这只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 重构词根 maihsa（沼泽）→ 古英语 mos（苔藓；沼地）→ 中古英语 → 英语 moss；核心义「潮湿之地的绿色生长物」。

sensesIntro.en: Moss starts as a name for bog growth, holds the plant and its green mat, spreads to a whole botany group, and then turns into the verb of laying it.
sensesIntro.cn: moss 最初指沼泽中生长之物，兼指植株与那层绿垫，后扩展为植物学上的类群，再由名词长出「铺苔」的动词义。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a green velvet pad unfolding on a wet stone.
core.cn: 核心意象：一块绿色丝绒垫在湿石头上慢慢铺开。

branches.en: The plant of damp shade is the sense most learners meet first.
branches.cn: 潮湿阴处的植株是学习者最先接触的义项。

branches.en: The mat of growth is the surface sense.
branches.cn: 连成一片的苔层是表面义项。

branches.en: Botany generalises the word to a whole plant class.
branches.cn: 植物学把这个词推广为一大类植物的名称。

branches.en: The verb names the act of laying moss on something.
branches.cn: 动词义指把苔藓铺在某物上的动作。

branches.en: Single plants and their green mat are really one image at two scales.
branches.cn: 单株与它铺成的绿垫其实是同一意象的两个尺度。

intro.en: Moss is a short root word of old English, whose family grows with -y, a comparative, and a plural that doubles as a group name.
intro.cn: moss 是古英语的短词根，其词族依靠 -y、比较级以及兼作类群名的复数扩展。

latinIntro.en: Latin has no relative of this word; it is native English and Germanic.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语中没有这个词的亲族，它是英语本土的日耳曼语词汇。

items.example: Moss is native English, not a Latin borrowing.
items.exampleCN: moss 是英语本土词，不是拉丁语借词。

items.example: Moss still keeps its short one-syllable shape.
items.exampleCN: moss 至今仍保持单音节短词形。

items.example: The suffix -y forms mossy.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -y 构成 mossy。

items.example: Mossy describes old stones and bark.
items.exampleCN: mossy 常形容老石头和树皮。

items.example: The suffix -er forms the comparative in mossier.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -er 在 mossier 中构成比较级。

items.example: The suffix -es forms mosses.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -es 构成 mosses。

items.example: Sphagnum moss builds peat in wet ground.
items.exampleCN: 泥炭藓在湿地里造出泥炭。

items.example: A moss-covered stone marks the old spring.
items.exampleCN: 一块覆满青苔的石头标出古泉的位置。

items.example: Bryology studies mosses and liverworts together.
items.exampleCN: 苔藓学把藓类与苔类放在一起研究。

latinEntries.meaningCN: 苔藓；一般认为与英语 moss 无关

definition_zh: 话筒；吹嘴；传声筒；代言人
definition_en: a part fitted over the mouth, or a person who speaks on behalf of others
core_image: 一支小管子扣在嘴唇上，声音必须从这一口出去
scene: 吹小号时，嘴唇贴住的金属小口决定了整首曲子的音色。A musician placed his lips against the mouthpiece of the trumpet and blew.
sceneCN: 这里 mouthpiece 是「吹嘴」（第 1 个义项：乐器的吹嘴）；句意：乐手把嘴唇贴住小号的吹嘴，吹了起来。

derivatives.zh: 嘴；口，构成 mouthpiece 的前半部分
件；片，构成 mouthpiece 的后半部分
mouth 加 -ful 构成，义为「一口之量」
mouth 加 -ing 构成，义为「不出声的口型动作」

senses.title: A part of a musical instrument
senses.definition: the part of a wind instrument that is placed against the lips
senses.definitionCN: 管乐器上贴着嘴唇吹奏的那一部分
senses.example: The trumpet has a small metal mouthpiece.
senses.exampleCN: 小号有一个小小的金属吹嘴。
senses.why: The word joins mouth and piece, so it first names the piece made for the mouth and used to play.
senses.whyCN: mouth 与 piece 复合，最先指的就是「为嘴而做的那一件」，即用来吹奏的部件。

senses.title: The part you speak into
senses.definition: the part of a telephone or radio that you speak into
senses.definitionCN: 电话或无线电设备上供人对着说话的部件
senses.example: He held the mouthpiece of the old phone close to his lips.
senses.exampleCN: 他把那部旧电话的送话口凑近嘴唇。
senses.why: The same image moves to devices for the voice, where the mouth-shaped part takes words in.
senses.whyCN: 同一个意象移到通话设备上，那块「嘴形」的部件负责把话语收进去。

senses.title: A person who speaks for others
senses.definition: a person or group that states the opinions of another person or organization
senses.definitionCN: 代表他人或组织表达意见的人或机构
senses.example: She became the mouthpiece of the young workers in the union.
senses.exampleCN: 她成了工会里年轻工人的代言人。
senses.why: A person can be the mouth-piece of an organisation, the channel through which its voice leaves.
senses.whyCN: 人也可以成为组织的「发声部件」，声音经由他传出去。

senses.title: A newspaper that repeats an authority
senses.definition: often disapproving: a newspaper or media outlet that repeats the views of a government or party
senses.definitionCN: 常含贬义：只重复政府或政党观点的报纸或媒体
senses.example: The paper was dismissed as a mere mouthpiece of the ministry.
senses.exampleCN: 这家报纸被贬为不过该部门的喉舌。
senses.why: When only one voice flows through the channel, the outlet becomes a propaganda mouthpiece.
senses.whyCN: 当只有一种声音从这个通道流出时，媒体就沦为宣传喉舌。

intro.en: Mouthpiece is a native English compound of mouth, from Old English muth, and piece, from Old French piece, a part or fragment.
intro.cn: mouthpiece 是本土英语复合词，由源自古英语 muth 的 mouth 与源自古法语 piece（部分、片段）的 piece 组合而成。

items.en: Muth names the mouth.
items.cn: muth 表示嘴。

items.en: Piece means a part or a fragment.
items.cn: piece 意为部分、片段。

items.en: The compound is first recorded in the sixteenth century; its exact date is uncertain.
items.cn: 该复合词首见于十六世纪，确切年代说法不一。

items.en: Mouthpiece names the speaking part of a instrument or a telephone.
items.cn: mouthpiece 用以指乐器或电话的送话部件。

items.en: The figurative sense of a spokesman or a party paper grows in the twentieth century.
items.cn: 二十世纪间「代言人、党报喉舌」的比喻义扩大开来。

note.en: Mouthpiece is a mouth plus piece compound, close to other compounds built from mouth and to words for people or parts that carry a voice.
note.cn: mouthpiece 是 mouth 加 piece 的复合词，与其它由 mouth 构成的复合词以及表示「发声者」「传声部件」的词相邻。

entries.definition: the opening in the face used for eating and speaking
entries.definitionCN: 脸部的口，用于进食与说话

entries.definition: a part or a portion of something
entries.definitionCN: 部分；一片；一件

entries.definition: a liquid used for rinsing the mouth
entries.definitionCN: 漱口水

entries.definition: a man who speaks on behalf of a group
entries.definitionCN: 男发言人

entries.definition: a person chosen to act or speak for others
entries.definitionCN: 代表

entries.definition: a cone that makes a voice louder
entries.definitionCN: 扩音喇叭

normalIntro.en: Mouthpiece is simply a piece for the mouth: two everyday English nouns joined into one word.
normalIntro.cn: mouthpiece 就是「嘴的那一件」：两个日常英语名词直接拼成一个词。

normal.en: A mouthpiece is a piece fitted to a mouth.
normal.cn: mouthpiece 是装在嘴上的那一件：嘴加一件。

normal.en: Speech into the mouthpiece is how telephone calls are made.
normal.cn: 对着送话口说话，就是打电话的方式。

normal.en: A party mouthpiece repeats the party line.
normal.cn: 政党喉舌只会重复政党的口径。

normal.en: Like doorstep and bookcase, the word is noun plus noun.
normal.cn: 像 doorstep 和 bookcase 一样，这个词是名词加名词。

normal.en: Compare spokesman: a spokesman is a person, a mouthpiece can be a person or a part.
normal.cn: 对比 spokesman：spokesman 一定是人，mouthpiece 可以是人也可以是部件。

abstract.en: Picture lips pressed against a small metal pipe.
abstract.cn: 想象嘴唇紧紧地贴在一根金属小管上。

abstract.en: Imagine an old telephone whose mouthpiece smells of dust.
abstract.cn: 想象一部旧电话，送话口上有一股灰尘味。

abstract.en: Think of a single microphone that everyone in the room must queue to use.
abstract.cn: 想象屋里所有人都得排队去用同一只话筒。

examples.en: Wipe the mouthpiece of the instrument before you play.
examples.cn: 吹奏前请擦拭乐器的吹嘴。

examples.en: The minister was accused of being a mouthpiece for big business.
examples.cn: 这位部长被指责为大企业的代言人。

examples.en: Several mouthpieces hung from the wall of the old exchange.
examples.cn: 旧交易所的墙上挂着几只送话口。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「猫斯披斯」——想象一只猫贴着话筒用力嘶叫；这只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 本土英语复合词：古英语 mouth（嘴）+ 古法语 piece（部分）→ mouthpiece（贴嘴的部件；代言人），核心义「声音必须经由的那一口」。

sensesIntro.en: Mouthpiece starts as the physical piece fitted to the mouth, then covers speaking parts of devices, and finally a person or paper that carries another voice.
sensesIntro.cn: mouthpiece 先指装在嘴上的实体部件，再扩大到设备的发声部件，最后指替别人发声的人或媒体。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a small tube pressed against the lips.
core.cn: 核心意象：一支小管子压在嘴唇上。

branches.en: The wind instrument sense keeps the physical piece.
branches.cn: 管乐器义保留实体部件的含义。

branches.en: The telephone sense moves the same piece to a talking device.
branches.cn: 电话义把同一部件移到了通话设备上。

branches.en: A spokesman sense makes a person the channel.
branches.cn: 代言人义把人变成了通道。

branches.en: The media sense turns the channel into propaganda.
branches.cn: 媒体义把通道变成了宣传工具。

branches.en: Both a telephone part and a party paper only pass a voice through.
branches.cn: 电话部件与党报喉舌都只是让一种声音通过。

intro.en: Mouthpiece is a transparent compound, with mouth and piece each carrying its own old English root.
intro.cn: mouthpiece 是透明的复合词，mouth 与 piece 各自携带着古老的词源。

latinIntro.en: Piece has no Latin origin; it comes from Old French piece, generally traced to a medieval Latin form such as petia.
latinIntro.cn: piece 并非直接来自拉丁语，它经古法语 piece 传入英语，一般认为可上溯到中世纪拉丁语的 petia 一类形式。

items.meaning: the opening for eating and speaking
items.example: Mouth supplies the first half of the compound.
items.exampleCN: mouth 提供复合词的前半部分。

items.example: Piece supplies the second half: one piece of the whole.
items.exampleCN: piece 提供后半部分，表示整体中的一件。

items.meaning: a part of a larger thing
items.example: The element -piece appears in earpiece and timepiece.
items.exampleCN: 词素 -piece 出现在 earpiece 与 timepiece 中。

items.meaning: the part worn at the ear
items.example: Earpiece is built the same way as mouthpiece.
items.exampleCN: earpiece 与 mouthpiece 的构词方式相同。

items.meaning: as much as fills the mouth
items.example: The suffix -ful turns mouth into mouthful.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ful 把 mouth 变成 mouthful。

items.example: Mouth-watering describes food that makes you hungry.
items.exampleCN: mouth-watering 形容令人食欲大开的食物。

items.example: Spokesman is the human rival of mouthpiece.
items.exampleCN: spokesman 是 mouthpiece 在「人」这一义上的对应词。

items.meaning: an instrument that magnifies the voice
items.example: Megaphone shares the idea of speaking through a device.
items.exampleCN: megaphone 与它共享「借助器械发声」的概念。

items.example: To mouth a word is to shape it with the lips.
items.exampleCN: mouth 一个词就是用嘴唇做出它的口型。

latinEntries.meaningCN: 一块；片段（一般认为的重构形式）

definition_zh: 污泥；粪肥；脏东西；弄脏；搞砸
definition_en: dirty wet soil, animal waste used as fertilizer, or to make something dirty
core_image: 脚踩进一片湿软的泥浆里，鞋立刻被裹住
scene: 雨后的田埂上，靴子踩进湿泥里，拔出来时带着一大块。After the rain, the farmer cleaned the muck from his boots with a stick.
sceneCN: 这里 muck 是「湿泥、污泥」（第 1 个义项：污湿的泥土）；句意：雨后，农民用一根棍子把靴子上的泥刮掉。

collocations.phrase: make a muck of the job

derivatives.zh: muck 加 -y 构成，义为「泥泞的；脏的」
muck 加 raker 构成，义为「专门揭露丑闻的记者」
muck 加 heap 构成，义为「粪堆；垃圾堆」

senses.title: Wet dirt on the ground
senses.definition: wet, sticky dirt or soil
senses.definitionCN: 湿润、黏稠的泥土或污垢
senses.example: The path was thick with muck after the storm.
senses.exampleCN: 暴雨过后，小路上积满了厚厚的泥。
senses.why: The oldest recorded use of the word is for soft wet dirt, the stuff a boot sinks into.
senses.whyCN: 这个词最早的用法就是指湿软的泥土，也就是靴子会陷进去的东西。

senses.title: Animal dung used on fields
senses.definition: solid animal waste, spread on land as fertilizer
senses.definitionCN: 动物的固体粪便，撒在田里当肥料
senses.example: They spread the muck over the vegetable beds.
senses.exampleCN: 他们把粪肥撒在菜畦上。
senses.why: Farmers turned the same wet dirt into a valued material once animals contributed to it.
senses.whyCN: 一旦混进了动物的排泄物，农民就把这种湿泥当成有价值的肥料。

senses.title: Something unpleasantly dirty
senses.definition: something filthy, grimy, or worthless that coats a surface
senses.definitionCN: 肮脏、油腻或无价值的东西，覆盖在物体表面
senses.example: Wipe that muck off the windscreen before you drive.
senses.exampleCN: 开车前把挡风玻璃上的脏东西擦掉。
senses.why: From field dirt the word spreads to any coating of filth that spoils a clean thing.
senses.whyCN: 从田里的泥扩展到任何弄脏洁净之物的污垢。

senses.title: To make something dirty
senses.definition: to cover or soil something with muck
senses.definitionCN: 用泥污把某物覆盖或弄脏
senses.example: The children mucked their shoes in the muddy yard.
senses.exampleCN: 孩子们把鞋子弄得满是院里的烂泥。
senses.why: The noun becomes a verb of action: putting the muck on.
senses.whyCN: 名词转为动词，表示把泥污糊上去的动作。

senses.title: To ruin or spoil a plan
senses.definition: to spoil or ruin something, especially by carelessness
senses.definitionCN: 把某事弄坏或搞砸，尤指因粗心造成
senses.example: He mucked up the whole arrangement with one email.
senses.exampleCN: 一封邮件就把整个安排搞砸了。
senses.why: If dirt spoils a clean surface, to muck up means to spoil an orderly plan.
senses.whyCN: 既然污垢能破坏干净的表面，那么 muck up 就表示把有序的计划弄乱。

intro.en: Muck is probably from Scandinavian; it is often compared with the Old Norse word for dung, myki, though the exact link is uncertain.
intro.cn: muck 一般认为源自斯堪的纳维亚语，常与古诺尔斯语中表示粪的 myki 相比较，但确切关系尚不确定。

items.en: The word is thought to come from the speech of Scandinavian settlers.
items.cn: 一般认为这个词来自斯堪的纳维亚移民的口语。

items.en: Scholars often point to myki, dung, as a related form.
items.cn: 学者常指出 myki（粪）是一个相关形式。

items.en: Muck is recorded in the thirteenth century in the sense of mud.
items.cn: muck 于十三世纪以「泥土」之义见于文献。

items.en: The word develops the sense of farm-yard dung for the fields.
items.cn: 该词发展出农田用粪肥的含义。

items.en: Muck gains the verb senses of to dirty and to spoil a plan.
items.cn: 现代英语中 muck 获得「弄脏」与「搞砸」的动词义。

note.en: Muck looks close to many muddy words and means roughly what dirt, mud, and manure mean, though it is more informal and agricultural.
note.cn: muck 在拼写上与许多「泥」类词相近，意思接近 dirt、mud 与 manure，但更口语、更偏农业。

entries.definition: covered in dirt or muck
entries.definitionCN: 满是泥污的

entries.definition: a strong smelling substance used in perfume; only similar in spelling, of a different origin
entries.definitionCN: 一种用于香水的强烈气味物质；只是拼写相近，词源不同

entries.definition: the black disc used in ice hockey; only similar in spelling, of a different origin
entries.definitionCN: 冰球比赛用的黑色圆盘；只是拼写相近，词源不同

entries.definition: wet sticky earth
entries.definitionCN: 湿黏的泥

entries.definition: any unclean matter, such as dust, soot, or soil
entries.definitionCN: 污物；尘土

entries.definition: animal waste used to fertilize land
entries.definitionCN: 粪肥

normalIntro.en: Muck is a short, blunt, earthy word, probably borrowed from Scandinavian and still tied to farms and stables.
normalIntro.cn: muck 是一个短促、直白的词，一般认为借自斯堪的纳维亚语，至今仍与农场和马厩相关。

normal.en: Muck out means to clear the dung from a stable.
normal.cn: muck out 指清理马厩里的粪便。

normal.en: Muck up means to make dirty or to spoil.
normal.cn: muck up 表示弄脏或搞砸。

normal.en: The adjective mucky adds -y to muck.
normal.cn: 形容词 mucky 由 muck 后加 -y 构成。

normal.en: Dirt is the general word, muck has the wet farm smell.
normal.cn: dirt 是通称，muck 带着农场湿泥的味道。

normal.en: Muck about is British and informal for wasting time.
normal.cn: muck about 是英式口语，表示瞎混、浪费时间。

abstract.en: Picture a boot sinking into grey-brown wet soil.
abstract.cn: 想象一只靴子陷进灰褐色的湿泥里。

abstract.en: Imagine spreading dark dung over a vegetable bed.
abstract.cn: 想象把深色粪肥撒在一片菜畦上。

abstract.en: Think of a clean window suddenly splashed with grime.
abstract.cn: 想象一扇干净的窗户突然被溅上了污垢。

examples.en: The lane was ankle-deep in muck after the rain.
examples.cn: 雨后那条小巷的泥深到脚踝。

examples.en: It took the whole morning to muck out the stable.
examples.cn: 清理马厩花了整整一个上午。

examples.en: He mucked up the presentation by deleting the last slides.
examples.cn: 他删掉了最后几页幻灯片，把演示稿搞砸了。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「马克」——马克笔一擦，纸上留下脏兮兮的墨泥；这只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 一般认为源自古诺尔斯语 myki（粪）一类形式，经斯堪的纳维亚移民带入英语，核心义「湿软、肮脏的泥泞之物」。

sensesIntro.en: Muck begins with wet ground dirt, grows into farm manure and any filth, and then becomes a verb for dirtying and for spoiling.
sensesIntro.cn: muck 从地面的湿泥开始，扩展为农田粪肥和各种污垢，再转为「弄脏」和「搞砸」的动词。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a boot sinking into wet, sticky ground.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只靴子陷进湿黏的地面。

branches.en: Wet ground dirt is the first recorded sense.
branches.cn: 湿泥是最早见于记载的义项。

branches.en: Field manure is the agricultural sense.
branches.cn: 农田粪肥是农业义项。

branches.en: Any dirty coating is the everyday sense.
branches.cn: 各种污垢覆盖是日常义项。

branches.en: The verb covers both dirtying and spoiling.
branches.cn: 动词用法兼指弄脏与搞砸。

branches.en: Wet soil and any dirt both leave a filthy coating.
branches.cn: 湿泥与污垢都会留下脏污的覆盖层。

intro.en: Muck is a short root with few affixes, but it builds a small family: mucky, muckraker, and muckheap.
intro.cn: muck 是一个短词根，词缀不多，却构成了一个小词族：mucky、muckraker 与 muckheap。

latinIntro.en: Muck is not a Latin word; its likely Scandinavian origin leaves no direct Latin family, though Latin does have words for dung and filth.
latinIntro.cn: muck 不是拉丁词，其可能的北欧来源使它在英语中没有直接的拉丁同族词，不过拉丁语本身有表示「粪」与「污秽」的词。

items.meaning: full of, having the quality of
items.meaningCN: 充满……的；具有……性质的词尾
items.example: The suffix -y turns muck into mucky.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -y 把 muck 变成 mucky。

items.example: Mucky describes a dirty floor or hand.
items.exampleCN: mucky 形容脏兮兮的地面或手。

items.example: The particle up gives the sense of spoiling.
items.exampleCN: 小品词 up 赋予「弄坏」的含义。

items.meaning: to behave foolishly or waste time
items.example: Muck about is informal British usage.
items.exampleCN: muck about 是英式非正式用法。

items.meaning: to clear dung from an animal shelter
items.example: Farmers muck out the stable each morning.
items.exampleCN: 农民每天早晨清理马厩。

items.meaning: one who gathers with a rake
items.example: The noun raker joins rake and the suffix -er.
items.exampleCN: 名词 raker 由 rake 与词尾 -er 结合而成。

items.example: Muckraker rakes the muck of public life.
items.exampleCN: muckraker 专门把公共生活中的丑闻耙出来。

items.example: Heap is the second part of muckheap.
items.exampleCN: heap 是 muckheap 的后半部分。

items.example: Muckheap is a pile kept on the farm.
items.exampleCN: muckheap 是农场里堆起来的一堆。

definition_zh: 混乱；糊涂；把……弄乱；使糊涂
definition_en: an untidy or confused state, or to mix things up and confuse them
core_image: 一堆颜色不同的毛线缠在一起，越扯越乱
scene: 抽屉里的单据、钥匙和充电线缠成一团，谁也分不开。After the move, all the boxes were muddled up and nothing could be found.
sceneCN: 这里 muddle 是「把……弄乱、混作一团」（第 1 个义项：把东西混杂打乱）；句意：搬家之后所有箱子都混在一起，什么都找不到。

derivatives.zh: muddle 加 -ed 构成，义为「混乱的；糊涂的」
muddle 加 -ing 构成，义为「令人糊涂的」
muddle 加 headed 构成，义为「头脑不清的」

senses.title: To mix things up
senses.definition: to put things into a disordered mixture so that they cannot be told apart
senses.definitionCN: 把东西混在一起，使它们难以分辨
senses.example: Someone muddled the files on my desk.
senses.exampleCN: 有人把我桌上的文件弄乱了。
senses.why: The core of the word is to make things cloudy and mixed, like stirring dirt into water.
senses.whyCN: 这个词的核心就是让东西变得浑浊混杂，像把泥搅进水里。

senses.title: A confused mess
senses.definition: an untidy or confusing condition
senses.definitionCN: 杂乱或令人摸不着头绪的状态
senses.example: The accounts were left in a complete muddle.
senses.exampleCN: 账目被弄得一塌糊涂。
senses.why: The action becomes a state: when everything has been stirred, the result is a muddle.
senses.whyCN: 动作转为状态：东西被搅过之后，留下的结果就是一团混乱。

senses.title: To confuse a person
senses.definition: to make someone unable to think clearly
senses.definitionCN: 使某人头脑混乱、无法清楚思考
senses.example: The sudden question muddled her and she forgot the answer.
senses.exampleCN: 这个突如其来的问题把她弄糊涂了，她忘了答案。
senses.why: Like muddy water, a mind can be stirred until its clear thoughts are lost.
senses.whyCN: 就像浑水一样，人的思路被搅动后，清晰的想法就消失了。

senses.title: To manage with difficulty
senses.definition: to get through a task or a period with difficulty and poor method
senses.definitionCN: 以困难而笨拙的方式完成任务或度过时期
senses.example: We muddled through the first week without any training.
senses.exampleCN: 头一个星期我们毫无培训，勉强应付了过去。
senses.why: To muddle through is to keep moving through a mess, step by uncertain step.
senses.whyCN: muddle through 就是在混乱中一步步摸索着往前走。

senses.title: A confused mental state
senses.definition: a state in which someone cannot think or remember clearly
senses.definitionCN: 指人无法清楚思考或记起事情的状态
senses.example: In his muddle he took the wrong train twice.
senses.exampleCN: 他糊里糊涂地坐错了两次车。
senses.why: The physical mess extends to the mind, where thoughts refuse to line up.
senses.whyCN: 外在的混乱延伸到头脑里，思绪无法排成一条线。

intro.en: Muddle is probably related to the muddy family, from mud and its Germanic relatives; the exact history is uncertain.
intro.cn: muddle 可能与「泥泞」词族有关，来自 mud 及其日耳曼语同源词；确切来源尚不确定。

items.en: A reconstructed Germanic root for mud lies behind the modern word.
items.cn: 该词的背后是一个重构的日耳曼语「泥」词根。

items.en: The verb appears in the sixteenth century; the oldest history is unclear.
items.cn: 动词形式于十六世纪出现，更早的演变尚不清楚。

items.en: Muddle also names a confused or intoxicated state.
items.cn: muddle 还指糊涂或醉酒的状态。

items.en: Muddle develops the idea of doing something clumsily.
items.cn: muddle 发展出「做事笨拙」的含义。

items.en: The phrase muddle through settles into common use.
items.cn: 短语 muddle through 逐渐固定在日常用法中。

note.en: Muddle belongs with the muddy family, and its meaning overlaps with confusion words such as confuse, mix, and mess.
note.cn: muddle 与「泥泞」词族相关，意义与 confuse、mix、mess 等表示混乱的词重叠。

entries.definition: wet sticky earth
entries.definitionCN: 湿黏的泥

entries.definition: confused and unable to think clearly
entries.definitionCN: 头脑糊涂的

entries.definition: the central part of something; only similar in spelling, of a different origin
entries.definitionCN: 中间；中部；只是拼写相近，词源不同

entries.definition: to make someone unable to understand
entries.definitionCN: 使困惑；弄糊涂

entries.definition: to mix things in an untidy way
entries.definitionCN: 使混杂；乱堆

entries.definition: a dirty or untidy state
entries.definitionCN: 脏乱；一团糟

normalIntro.en: Muddle sounds like mud plus a small ending, and the image of mud stirred into water explains both the mess and the confusion.
normalIntro.cn: muddle 听起来像 mud 加上一个小词尾，而「把泥搅进水里」的画面同时解释了混乱与糊涂。

normal.en: To muddle is to make things muddy, mixed, and unclear.
normal.cn: muddle 就是让东西变得浑浊、混杂、看不清。

normal.en: Muddle up means to mix things so they cannot be sorted.
normal.cn: muddle up 指把东西混到无法分拣。

normal.en: Muddle through means to cope without a proper plan.
normal.cn: muddle through 表示没有像样的计划也勉强应付过去。

normal.en: Muddled papers are shuffled papers.
normal.cn: muddled 的文件就是被打乱顺序的文件。

normal.en: A middle is a center, a muddle is a mess: compare spelling only.
normal.cn: middle 表示中间，muddle 表示混乱，二者只比较拼写。

abstract.en: Picture a ball of coloured wool pulled into knots.
abstract.cn: 想象一团彩色毛线被拽成了一个又一个结。

abstract.en: Imagine stirring a spoon through a jar of cloudy mud.
abstract.cn: 想象用勺子在满是浊泥的罐子里搅动。

abstract.en: Think of steps taken in fog, each one unsure.
abstract.cn: 想象在雾里迈步，每一步都拿不准。

examples.en: My notes were muddled up with hers in the shared folder.
examples.cn: 在共享文件夹里，我的笔记和她的笔记混在了一起。

examples.en: After the flood, the paperwork was in a terrible muddle.
examples.cn: 洪水过后，文书档案乱七八糟。

examples.en: Without a guide, they had to muddle through the mountain route.
examples.cn: 没有向导，他们只好摸索着走完了山路。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「妈的」——东西又乱成一团，忍不住抱怨一声；这只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 一般认为与 mud（泥）及其日耳曼语源头相关，核心义「把泥搅进水里，使浑浊混杂」，引申为「混乱、糊涂」。

sensesIntro.en: Muddle starts with the act of stirring things into confusion, becomes the resulting mess and mental confusion, and ends in the phrase for coping clumsily.
sensesIntro.cn: muddle 先指把东西搅乱的动作，再指造成的混乱与头脑的糊涂，最后进入表示「勉强应付」的短语。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: tangled threads in a drawer.
core.cn: 核心意象：抽屉里缠成一团的线。

branches.en: The action sense mixes things beyond sorting.
branches.cn: 动作义指把东西混到无法分拣。

branches.en: The state sense is the resulting mess.
branches.cn: 状态义指混合留下的混乱。

branches.en: The mental sense stirs a person instead of things.
branches.cn: 心理义搅动的是人而不是物。

branches.en: Muddling through is coping inside the mess.
branches.cn: 勉强应付就是在混乱中硬撑过去。

branches.en: An outer muddle and an inner muddle share the same unclear shape.
branches.cn: 外在混乱与内在糊涂有着同样的「看不清」形态。

intro.en: Muddle takes the endings -ed, -ing, and -head, and lives in phrases such as muddle through and muddle up.
intro.cn: muddle 可以接 -ed、-ing 与 head 等结尾，也活跃在 muddle through、muddle up 等短语中。

latinIntro.en: Muddle is of Germanic rather than Latin stock, but Latin has words such as turbare, to disturb, that match its muddy idea.
latinIntro.cn: muddle 属于日耳曼语而非拉丁语来源，不过拉丁语有 turbare（搅动）这类词，与它「搅浑」的意象相合。

items.example: The suffix -ed forms the adjective muddled.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ed 构成形容词 muddled。

items.example: Muddled thinking leads to muddled plans.
items.exampleCN: 混乱的思路导致混乱的计划。

items.example: The suffix -ing forms muddling.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ing 构成 muddling。

items.meaning: having a certain kind of head
items.example: The element -headed forms muddleheaded.
items.exampleCN: 词素 -headed 构成 muddleheaded。

items.example: Head is the base of muddleheaded.
items.exampleCN: head 是 muddleheaded 的词基。

items.meaning: from one end to the other
items.example: Through turns muddle into muddle through.
items.exampleCN: through 把 muddle 变成 muddle through。

items.example: Up turns muddle into muddle up.
items.exampleCN: up 把 muddle 变成 muddle up。

items.example: Along forms the phrase muddle along.
items.exampleCN: along 构成短语 muddle along。

items.example: Mud is the near twin of muddle.
items.exampleCN: mud 是 muddle 的近亲词。

definition_zh: 泥泞的；浑浊的；暗淡不清的；混乱不清的
definition_en: full of or covered with mud, and unclear or confused
core_image: 刚下过雨的土路：鞋底陷进稀泥，抬脚就带出一串泥印
scene: 下过雨的山道上，背包客停在一块积水的土坑前。The hikers paused before a muddy path that led up to the ridge.
sceneCN: 这里 muddy 是「泥泞的」（第 1 个义项：路面满是泥、踩下去会下陷）；句意：登山者在一条泥泞的小路前停下，那条路通向山脊。

pos.zh: 泥泞的；浑浊的；暗淡不清的；混乱的

collocations.zh: 把水搅浑；使情况变得混乱不清

derivatives.zh: 基础名词，义为「泥；烂泥」，muddy 就是「一身是泥」
muddy 加 -ness 构成，义为「泥泞；浑浊；模糊」
动词 muddy 的动名词，义为「搅浑；使混乱」
mud 加 slinging 构成，义为「（竞选中的）抹黑攻击」，与 muddy 共享泥巴意象

senses.title: Covered with mud
senses.definition: covered with or full of soft wet earth
senses.definitionCN: 覆盖着或充满软湿泥土的
senses.example: Our boots were muddy after the walk.
senses.exampleCN: 散步之后我们的靴子沾满了泥。
senses.why: Muddy is simply the noun mud turned into an adjective, so what has mud on it is muddy.
senses.whyCN: muddy 就是名词 mud 加词尾变成的形容词，身上有泥，自然就是「泥泞的」。

senses.title: Not clear, as water
senses.definition: dark and full of suspended particles, so that you cannot see through it
senses.definitionCN: 黑暗且充满悬浮颗粒，因而看不透的
senses.example: The river ran muddy after the storm.
senses.exampleCN: 暴风雨过后河水变得浑浊。
senses.why: When soil is stirred into water it stops being clear, so the image of mud spreads to any cloudy liquid.
senses.whyCN: 泥土被搅进水里，水就不再清澈，于是「泥」的意象扩展到一切浑浊的液体。

senses.title: Dull in colour
senses.definition: not bright or pure in colour, mixed with dirt tones
senses.definitionCN: 颜色不鲜亮、不纯，混着土色的
senses.example: The walls had faded to a muddy brown.
senses.exampleCN: 墙壁已经褪成暗淡的棕色。
senses.why: Colours mixed with dirt lose their sharpness, so a dull shade looks as if mud has been stirred in.
senses.whyCN: 颜色一混进泥土就失去锐度，所以暗淡的色调就像被搅进了泥。

senses.title: Confused or unclear
senses.definition: unclear in thought or expression, so that it is hard to follow
senses.definitionCN: 思想或表达不清楚，因而难以理解的
senses.example: His argument was muddy and hard to follow.
senses.exampleCN: 他的论证混乱不清，难以跟上。
senses.why: Clear water is the picture of clear thinking, so muddy water becomes the picture of muddy ideas.
senses.whyCN: 清水是思路清晰的图像，浊水便顺理成章成了思路混乱的图像。

senses.title: To make unclear
senses.definition: to make water dirty or to make an issue less clear
senses.definitionCN: 把水弄脏，或使问题变得不那么清楚
senses.example: Such remarks only muddy the debate.
senses.exampleCN: 这类言论只会把辩论搅得更乱。
senses.why: The verb turns the adjective into an action: someone stirs the mud and makes things less clear.
senses.whyCN: 动词把形容词变成动作：有人把泥搅起来，让事情变得更不清楚。

intro.en: Muddy is formed inside English from the noun mud plus the old adjective ending -y.
intro.cn: muddy 是在英语内部由名词 mud 加古形容词词尾 -y 构成的。

items.en: The reconstructed form mudde is usually linked to a word for wet earth.
items.cn: 一般认为，重构形式 mudde 与表示「湿土」的词有关。

items.en: Mudde means thick wet dirt, and related forms appear in Dutch.
items.cn: mudde 意为浓稠的湿泥，荷兰语中也有相关形式。

items.en: Mud is recorded in English as a noun for soft wet earth.
items.cn: 中古英语在十四世纪用 mud 指软湿的泥土。

items.en: Muddy appears as the adjective built from mud plus -y.
items.cn: 十五世纪出现由 mud 加 -y 构成的形容词 muddy。

items.en: The word extends from wet earth to cloudy water and dull colour.
items.cn: 这个词从湿泥扩展到浑浊的水与暗淡的颜色。

items.en: Muddy also describes confused ideas, and the verb means to make things unclear.
items.cn: 现代英语中 muddy 还形容混乱的想法，动词义为「使不清楚」。

note.en: Muddy sits in the mud word family and is close to other words for wet messy ground and for unclear things.
note.cn: muddy 属于 mud 这一词族，并与「湿泥地」和「不清楚」两类词相邻。

entries.definition: soft wet earth
entries.definitionCN: 泥；烂泥

entries.definition: the state of being muddy
entries.definitionCN: 泥泞；浑浊；模糊

entries.definition: made muddy or confused
entries.definitionCN: 被弄脏的；被搅乱的

entries.definition: wet and soft, often with water
entries.definitionCN: 湿透的

entries.definition: dark and hard to see through
entries.definitionCN: 昏暗的；浑浊的

entries.definition: not clear, as liquid or as thought
entries.definitionCN: 浑浊的；模糊的

normalIntro.en: Muddy is just mud plus y: if there is mud, muddy is the word you want.
normalIntro.cn: muddy 就是 mud 加 y：只要有泥，就是 muddy。

normal.en: Mud plus y gives muddy, the adjective for anything covered with mud.
normal.cn: mud 加 y 得 muddy，凡沾着泥的东西都用它。

normal.en: Muddy water cannot be seen through, which links the word to unclearness.
normal.cn: muddy water 看不清底，这层联系让词义延伸到「不清楚」。

normal.en: To muddy the waters is to make a simple matter complicated.
normal.cn: muddy the waters 就是把简单的事搅成浑水。

normal.en: Compare muddy and muddying: one describes, the other stirs the mud.
normal.cn: 对比 muddy 与 muddying：一个在描述，一个在搅泥。

normal.en: Muddy has no bare -ed adjective beyond muddied, so use muddied boots for grammar.
normal.cn: muddy 没有单独的 -ed 形容词，语法上要说 muddied boots。

abstract.en: Picture a rain boot sinking into wet earth with a soft sound.
abstract.cn: 想象雨靴陷进湿泥时那声闷响。

abstract.en: Imagine a glass of pond water going brown as the bottom is stirred.
abstract.cn: 想象一塘水被搅动后从清变浑的过程。

abstract.en: Think of a photo whose colours have all run together into brown.
abstract.cn: 想象一张照片的颜色全都混成棕色。

examples.en: The children came home with muddy shoes.
examples.cn: 孩子们回家时鞋子沾满了泥。

examples.en: Heavy rain left the stadium pitch too muddy to play on.
examples.cn: 大雨让球场变得泥泞不堪，无法比赛。

examples.en: Please do not muddy the water with details nobody asked for.
examples.cn: 请不要用没人问的细节把水搅浑。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「马迪」——马迪一路踩过烂泥地，鞋上全是泥；这只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 中古英语 mud（泥）+ 形容词词尾 -y；一般认为更早的重构形式 mudde 与低地德语、荷兰语的「湿泥」词同源。

sensesIntro.en: Muddy starts from physical mud, moves through cloudy water and dull colour, and ends in the abstract sense of confused ideas and the action of making things unclear.
sensesIntro.cn: muddy 从实体的「泥泞」出发，经历「浑浊的水」「暗淡的颜色」，最后落到抽象的「思路混乱」以及「把事搅浑」的动作。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a boot sinking into wet mud after rain.
core.cn: 核心意象：雨后一脚踩进烂泥里。

branches.en: What is covered with mud is literally muddy.
branches.cn: 沾上泥的东西就是字面意义上的泥泞。

branches.en: Particles in water make it look like liquid mud.
branches.cn: 水中的颗粒让它看起来像液态的泥。

branches.en: Shades mixed with earth tones lose their sharpness.
branches.cn: 色调一旦混入土色就失去锐度。

branches.en: Unclear ideas are like water that has been stirred.
branches.cn: 混乱的想法就像被搅动过的水。

branches.en: The noun image supplies both the dirty state and the act of making something dirty.
branches.cn: 泥的意象既提供「脏的状态」，也提供「弄脏的动作」。

intro.en: Muddy is mud plus the adjective suffix -y, with nouns and forms built around the same small family.
intro.cn: muddy 是 mud 加形容词词尾 -y，整个小词族都围绕「泥」展开。

latinIntro.en: This word has no Latin ancestor; it comes from Germanic sources through English, so the Latin list is left empty.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词没有拉丁语祖先，经由日耳曼语源进入英语，因此拉丁同源词留空。

items.example: Mud is the base noun of the family.
items.exampleCN: mud 是这个词族的基础名词。

items.example: The suffix -y turns mud into muddy.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -y 把 mud 变成 muddy。

items.example: Muddy describes ground covered with wet earth.
items.exampleCN: muddy 形容地面满是湿泥。

items.example: The suffix -ness forms muddiness.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ness 构成 muddiness。

items.example: Muddiness names the state of being muddy.
items.exampleCN: muddiness 指泥泞的状态。

items.example: Y becomes i before -er, giving muddier.
items.exampleCN: y 在 -er 前变 i，形成 muddier。

items.example: Muddier compares two states of mud.
items.exampleCN: muddier 比较两种泥泞程度。

items.example: The suffix -ing forms the verb form muddying.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ing 构成动词形式 muddying。

items.example: Muddying the waters creates confusion.
items.exampleCN: 搅浑水就是制造混乱。

definition_zh: 跨国的；多国的；跨国公司
definition_en: involving or operating in several countries; also a large company that does business in many countries
core_image: 一架喷气机同时飞越好几面国旗：机身上的航线连接着不同国家的城市
scene: 日内瓦峰会的会场里，代表们讨论税制，桌上摊着好几个国家的国旗小牌。Yet another multinational oil firm has agreed to the new tax rules.
sceneCN: 这里 multinational 是「跨国的」（第 1 个义项：业务横跨多个国家）；句意：又有一家跨国石油公司同意遵守新的税收规定。

pos.zh: 跨国的；多国的；多民族国家的

derivatives.zh: 基础名词，义为「民族；国家」，multinational 以它为核心
加 -al 构成的形容词，义为「国家的；全国的」
multinational 加 -ism 构成，义为「跨国经营主义；多国主义」
multinational 加 -ization 构成，义为「跨国化；多国化」

senses.title: Working in many countries
senses.definition: having offices, factories, or sales in several different countries
senses.definitionCN: 在多个不同国家设有办事处、工厂或销售渠道的
senses.example: She works for a multinational car maker.
senses.exampleCN: 她在一家跨国汽车制造商工作。
senses.why: Multi- means many and nation supplies the countries, so the adjective names anything spreading over several nations at once.
senses.whyCN: multi- 表示「多」，nation 提供「国家」，两者相加就指向同时横跨多个国家的事物。

senses.title: Involving several states
senses.definition: involving troops or governments of more than one state, often under a joint command
senses.definitionCN: 涉及一个以上国家的部队或政府，通常由联合指挥部领导的
senses.example: The council sent a multinational force to the border.
senses.exampleCN: 理事会向边境派出了多国部队。
senses.why: The same prefix can describe cooperation between states rather than commerce, so a joint force is multinational too.
senses.whyCN: 同一个前缀也可以描述国家之间的合作而非商业行为，所以联合部队同样是 multinational。

senses.title: The company itself
senses.definition: a large business that owns or controls production or services in more than one country
senses.definitionCN: 在一国以上拥有或控制生产或服务的大型企业
senses.example: Several multinationals moved their headquarters abroad.
senses.exampleCN: 几家跨国公司把总部迁到了国外。
senses.why: English often turns such adjectives into nouns, so the describing word becomes the name of the company.
senses.whyCN: 英语常把这类形容词转为名词，于是描述性的词就成了公司本身的名称。

senses.title: Built from many peoples
senses.definition: containing several nations or peoples inside one state
senses.definitionCN: 在一个国家内部包含多个民族或多个族群的
senses.example: The country is a multinational state with many languages.
senses.exampleCN: 这个国家是一个使用多种语言的多民族国家。
senses.why: Nation also means a people rather than a state, so a multinational state holds more than one people.
senses.whyCN: nation 也可以指「民族」而不只是「国家」，所以多民族的国家就是 multinational state。

senses.title: Run across borders
senses.definition: organised or managed across several national systems at once
senses.definitionCN: 同时跨越多个国家体系来组织或管理的
senses.example: Its multinational structure lets it shift profits between countries.
senses.exampleCN: 它的跨国结构让它可以在国家之间转移利润。
senses.why: Once a firm is spread out, the word also describes how its structure and management are arranged.
senses.whyCN: 一旦企业铺开，这个词也用来描述它的组织结构与管理方式是如何安排的。

intro.en: Multinational is a compound of the Latin prefix multi-, meaning many, and the noun nation.
intro.cn: multinational 由拉丁语前缀 multi-（多）与名词 nation 复合而成。

items.en: Multus means much or many, and natio means birth or a group of people born together.
items.cn: multus 意为「多」，natio 意为「出生」或「一同出生的人群」。

items.en: Nation enters French with the sense of a people or a country.
items.cn: natio 进入法语，指一个民族或一个国家。

items.en: Nation is recorded in English for a people sharing descent or government.
items.cn: 十四世纪英语用 nation 指共享血统或政府的人群。

items.en: The prefix multi- is added to nation to form multinational, first in political writing.
items.cn: 十九世纪在 nation 前加上 multi- 构成 multinational，最初用于政治写作。

items.en: Combining multination and -al gives the modern spelling multinational.
items.cn: multination 与 -al 结合，出现现代拼法 multinational。

items.en: After the war the word moves into business, naming companies that trade across borders.
items.cn: 战后这个词进入商业领域，用来称呼跨境经营的公司。

note.en: Multinational belongs to the nation word family and is close to business words for companies working beyond one home country.
note.cn: multinational 属于 nation 词族，并与描述「走出单一母国」的商业用词相邻。

entries.definition: a people or a country
entries.definitionCN: 民族；国家

entries.definition: belonging to one country
entries.definitionCN: 国家的；全国的

entries.definition: using several languages
entries.definitionCN: 使用多种语言的

entries.definition: between countries
entries.definitionCN: 国际的；国与国之间的

entries.definition: covering the whole world
entries.definitionCN: 全球的

entries.definition: operating across national borders
entries.definitionCN: 跨国的；超越国界的

normalIntro.en: Solve the word like a sum: multi- means many, nation means country, and -al makes it describe.
normalIntro.cn: 把这个词当算式来记：multi- 是多，nation 是国家，-al 让它变成形容词。

normal.en: Multi- is the same many in multiple, multiply, and multimedia.
normal.cn: multi- 与 multiple、multiply、multimedia 里的「多」是同一个。

normal.en: Nation plus -al gives national, so multinational is many countries described.
normal.cn: nation 加 -al 成 national，所以 multinational 就是「多国」的描述。

normal.en: A multinational company is a multinational, and the plural is multinationals.
normal.cn: a multinational company 可以简称 a multinational，复数是 multinationals。

normal.en: International stresses relations between states, while multinational stresses the spread of one firm.
normal.cn: international 强调国与国之间的关系，multinational 强调一家企业的铺展。

normal.en: Multinational force is the usual word for troops from many states.
normal.cn: 多国部队的常见说法是 multinational force。

abstract.en: Picture one factory roof with flags of five countries flying above it.
abstract.cn: 想象一座厂房顶上飘着五个国家的国旗。

abstract.en: Imagine a map where a single delivery route crosses six borders.
abstract.cn: 想象一张地图上，一条送货路线穿过六道国界。

abstract.en: Think of a company name printed on ships, lorries, and planes alike.
abstract.cn: 想象同一个公司名同时印在轮船、卡车和飞机上。

examples.en: The multinational employs more than sixty thousand people.
examples.cn: 这家跨国公司雇用了六万多人。

examples.en: Governments are trying to tax multinational profits more fairly.
examples.cn: 各国政府正努力更公平地对跨国利润征税。

examples.en: Many multinationals now publish yearly reports on carbon emissions.
examples.cn: 许多跨国公司现在每年发布碳排放报告。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「玛提内神诺」——玛提一个人在一张地图上圈出好几个国家，忙得像跨国公司老板；这只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 multus（多）+ natio（出生；人群）→ nation（国家；民族）+ 形容词词尾 -al，整体义为「多国的」。

sensesIntro.en: Multinational begins as an adjective for businesses that operate across borders, extends to joint forces and multi-people states, and then becomes a noun naming the company.
sensesIntro.cn: multinational 先作形容词指跨境经营的企业，继而扩展到多国联合部队与多民族国家，最后名词化，直接指「跨国公司」。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: one jet route crossing the flags of several countries.
core.cn: 核心意象：一条航线同时穿过好几面国旗。

branches.en: The commercial adjective is the most common use.
branches.cn: 商业上的形容词用法最为常见。

branches.en: States that act together are also many nations joined.
branches.cn: 共同行动的国家也是多个国家的结合。

branches.en: The noun is the describing word turned into a name.
branches.cn: 名词用法是形容词转成的名称。

branches.en: Nation as a people gives the multi-people state.
branches.cn: nation 作「民族」解时，就得到多民族国家。

branches.en: Cross-border structure and cross-border business are two sides of one fact.
branches.cn: 跨境结构与跨境经营是同一事实的两面。

intro.en: Multinational is built from the prefix multi- and the noun nation, with the adjective suffix -al on top.
intro.cn: multinational 由前缀 multi- 与名词 nation 组成，再叠加形容词词尾 -al。

latinIntro.en: Latin multus supplies the many, and Latin natio supplies the born group of people behind nation.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 multus 提供「多」义，拉丁语 natio 提供 nation 背后「同源人群」的义。

items.example: The prefix multi- appears in many English words.
items.exampleCN: 前缀 multi- 出现在许多英语单词中。

items.example: Nation is the core noun of this family.
items.exampleCN: nation 是这个词族的核心名词。

items.example: The suffix -al turns national into an adjective.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -al 使 national 成为形容词。

items.example: National is the single-nation counterpart.
items.exampleCN: national 是「单国」的对应词。

items.example: Multinational adds the many to national.
items.exampleCN: multinational 在 national 上加了「多」。

items.example: International uses the inter- prefix instead.
items.exampleCN: international 换用 inter- 前缀。

items.example: The suffix -s gives the plural multinationals.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -s 构成复数 multinationals。

items.example: The suffix -ism forms multinationalism.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ism 构成 multinationalism。

items.example: The suffix -ization forms multinationalization.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ization 构成 multinationalization。

latinEntries.example: Natio becomes the English noun nation.

definition_zh: 大量；众多；人群；普通民众
definition_en: a very large number of people or things; also the ordinary people as a group
core_image: 站台尽头一片攒动的人头：数不清的人潮同时向检票口涌去
scene: 清晨的地铁站台，一列列车进站，门还没开，人群已经挤到黄线边上。A multitude of commuters pressed forward as the doors slid open.
sceneCN: 这里 multitude 是「众多的人」（第 1 个义项：数量极大的人群）；句意：车门滑开时，一大群通勤者向前挤去。

derivatives.zh: 同出于 multus，义为「多个的；多重的」
同出于 multus，义为「乘；繁殖；增多」
multitude 加 -inous 构成，义为「为数众多的；形形色色的」
multiply 加 -ier 构成，义为「乘数；增加者」，与 multitude 同词族

senses.title: A very large number
senses.definition: a very great number of people or things seen as one mass
senses.definitionCN: 作为一个整体来看的极大量的人或事物
senses.example: A multitude of stars covered the sky.
senses.exampleCN: 天空中布满了无数星星。
senses.why: Latin multus means many, and the suffix -tudo turns that quality into a noun: the state of being many.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 multus 意为「多」，词尾 -tudo 把这个性质变成名词：也就是「多」这种状态。

senses.title: A crowd of people
senses.definition: a large crowd of people gathered in one place
senses.definitionCN: 聚集在一处的一大群人
senses.example: A multitude gathered outside the town hall.
senses.exampleCN: 一大群人聚集在市政厅外。
senses.why: Once the noun names a great number, it naturally comes to name a mass of people standing together.
senses.whyCN: 名词一旦表示「数量极大」，自然就用来指站在一起的一片人群。

senses.title: The common people
senses.definition: ordinary people as a body, often set against rulers or experts
senses.definitionCN: 作为整体的普通人们，常与统治者或专家相对
senses.example: The speaker claimed to represent the multitude.
senses.exampleCN: 演讲者声称自己代表大众。
senses.why: Because the crowd is many while rulers are few, the noun became a name for ordinary people as a whole.
senses.whyCN: 人群人数众多，而掌权者总是少数，于是这个词成了「一般人」的整体称呼。

senses.title: Endless variety
senses.definition: the great variety among the many items of one kind
senses.definitionCN: 同一类事物在数量众多时呈现出的巨大差异
senses.example: The market offered a multitude of colours and smells.
senses.exampleCN: 市场里有形形色色的颜色和气味。
senses.why: When there are very many of something, the many also brings variety, so the word can stress difference as well as number.
senses.whyCN: 当某类东西多得数不清时，「多」也带来「不同」，所以这个词除了数量也强调差异。

senses.title: Many reasons together
senses.definition: used with of to say that there are many of the same abstract thing
senses.definitionCN: 与 of 连用，表示同类抽象事物有许多个
senses.example: There are a multitude of reasons to save water.
senses.exampleCN: 节约用水的理由有许许多多。
senses.why: The fixed pattern a multitude of lets the noun pile up abstract items as if they were a crowd.
senses.whyCN: 固定搭配 a multitude of 让抽象事物像人群一样被堆叠起来计数。

intro.en: Multitude comes from the Latin noun multitudo, built on multus, meaning much or many.
intro.cn: multitude 来自拉丁语名词 multitudo，以 multus（多）为词干构成。

items.en: Multus means much or many and is the base of multiplication words.
items.cn: multus 意为「多」，也是 multiplication 一类词的词基。

items.en: The suffix -tudo forms abstract nouns, giving multitudo for a great number.
items.cn: 词尾 -tudo 构成抽象名词，于是得到表示「众多」的 multitudo。

items.en: Multitude passes into French as a noun of a large number or a crowd.
items.cn: multitudo 进入法语，指数量众多或人群。

items.en: Middle English borrows the word through French with the sense of a great crowd.
items.cn: 中古英语经由法语借入，指一大群人。

items.en: The sense widens from people to things and then to abstract items.
items.cn: 词义从人扩展到事物，再扩展到抽象对象。

items.en: The phrase a multitude of becomes a standard way to express a great many.
items.cn: 现代英语中 a multitude of 成为表达「大量」的标准说法。

note.en: Multitude shares the multus root with multiple and multiply, and is close to words for crowds and for large numbers.
note.cn: multitude 与 multiple、multiply 共享 multus 词根，并与表示人群与大量的一类词相邻。

entries.definition: several or many
entries.definitionCN: 多个的；多重的

entries.definition: to increase in number
entries.definitionCN: 乘；繁殖；增多

entries.definition: very numerous
entries.definitionCN: 为数众多的；形形色色的

entries.definition: many people in one place
entries.definitionCN: 人群；人群密集

entries.definition: a very large number
entries.definitionCN: 大量；许多

entries.definition: a very large quantity, more than enough
entries.definitionCN: 丰富；充裕

normalIntro.en: Read the word in pieces: multi- gives the many, and the ending turns that many into a noun.
normalIntro.cn: 把词拆开读：multi- 提供「多」，结尾把这个「多」变成名词。

normal.en: Multi- in multitude is the same many as in multiple and multiply.
normal.cn: multitude 里的 multi- 与 multiple、multiply 里的「多」是同一个。

normal.en: The ending is like the one in magnitude and gratitude, so a quality becomes a noun.
normal.cn: 词尾与 magnitude、gratitude 相同，把性质变成名词。

normal.en: A multitude of takes a plural noun after of.
normal.cn: a multitude of 后面接复数名词。

normal.en: The multitude with the article suggests the masses rather than just a count.
normal.cn: the multitude 带定冠词时暗示「大众」，而不只是一个数量。

normal.en: Compare many and multitude: multitude is formal and often pictures a crowd.
normal.cn: 对比 many 与 multitude：后者更正式，而且常带「人群」的画面。

abstract.en: Picture a stadium wave where every seat holds a person.
abstract.cn: 想象体育场里每个座位都坐着人，人浪一圈圈翻起。

abstract.en: Imagine grains of sand slipping through one open hand.
abstract.cn: 想象沙粒从摊开的手掌里流下去。

abstract.en: Think of a single microphone facing a thousand raised hands.
abstract.cn: 想象一只话筒面对一千只举起的手。

examples.en: A multitude of small decisions shaped the final design.
examples.cn: 许多细小的决定塑造了最终的设计。

examples.en: The new park attracts multitudes every weekend.
examples.cn: 这座新公园每个周末都吸引成群的人。

examples.en: The minister promised to listen to the multitude.
examples.cn: 部长承诺倾听民众的声音。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「妈提土」——妈妈提着一筐土，到了地头一撒，土粒多到数不过来；这只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 multus（多）+ 名词词尾 -tudo（性质、状态）→ multitudo（众多）→ 古法语 multitude → 英语 multitude，核心义为「众多」。

sensesIntro.en: Multitude grows from the bare idea of many into a crowd of people, then into the ordinary people, into variety, and finally into the fixed phrase a multitude of with abstract nouns.
sensesIntro.cn: multitude 从单纯的「多」出发，长成「人群」，再指「普通民众」，又指「种类繁多」，最后凝固为 a multitude of 与抽象名词搭配。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a sea of heads surging towards one gate.
core.cn: 核心意象：一片攒动的人头涌向同一个闸口。

branches.en: A great number is the abstract core of the noun.
branches.cn: 数量极多是这个词的抽象核心。

branches.en: A crowd is the many made visible as bodies.
branches.cn: 人群就是让「多」变成看得见的身体。

branches.en: The masses are the crowd seen from above, without names.
branches.cn: 大众就是从高处看、没有名字的那群人。

branches.en: Many different items bring variety along with number.
branches.cn: 许多不同的事物让「多」同时带上「杂」。

branches.en: The fixed phrase a multitude of carries the same number onto reasons and problems.
branches.cn: 固定搭配 a multitude of 把同样的「多」带到理由与问题上。

intro.en: Multitude is built on the Latin base mult-, seen as well in multiple, multiply, and multinational.
intro.cn: multitude 建立在拉丁词基 mult- 上，multiple、multiply、multinational 也共享它。

latinIntro.en: Latin multus means much or many, and the suffix -tudo forms abstract nouns of state and quality.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 multus 意为「多」，词尾 -tudo 构成表示状态与性质的抽象名词。

items.example: The base mult- sits inside many English words.
items.exampleCN: 词基 mult- 藏在许多英语单词里。

items.example: The prefix multi- builds multiple and multilingual.
items.exampleCN: 前缀 multi- 构成 multiple 与 multilingual。

items.example: The suffix -tudo forms abstract nouns.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -tudo 构成抽象名词。

items.example: Multitudo is the direct source of multitude.
items.exampleCN: multitudo 是 multitude 的直接来源。

items.example: The suffix -itude appears in magnitude and gratitude.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -itude 出现在 magnitude 与 gratitude 中。

items.example: Multitude keeps the Latin number sense.
items.exampleCN: multitude 保留了拉丁语的「多」义。

items.example: The suffix -s gives the plural multitudes.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -s 构成复数 multitudes。

items.example: The suffix -inous forms multitudinous.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -inous 构成 multitudinous。

items.example: Multitudinous describes what is very many.
items.exampleCN: multitudinous 形容数量极多。

latinEntries.example: Multus gives the sense of many.

definition_zh: 平凡的；平淡乏味的；世俗的
definition_en: ordinary and lacking excitement, or belonging to the everyday and earthly world rather than the spiritual one
core_image: 一扇旧木门里每天重复的扫地、倒水与洗衣服
scene: 假期结束后的清晨，又回到挤地铁、开例会、洗碗的老节奏。The holidays are over, and she is back to the mundane business of commuting, meetings and washing up.
sceneCN: 这里 mundane 是「平淡日常的」（第 1 个义项：与宗教、精神世界相对的世俗世界）；句意为假期结束，她又回到通勤、开会、洗碗这些平淡的日常事务。

pos.zh: 世俗的；尘世的（与精神、宗教世界相对）

derivatives.zh: 由 mundane 加副词后缀 -ly 构成：平平淡淡地；世俗地
由 mundane 加名词后缀 -ity 构成：平凡；世俗性；平淡乏味
由 mundane 加名词后缀 -ness 构成：平淡；凡俗

senses.title: Belonging to the earthly world
senses.definition: relating to the everyday physical world rather than to spiritual or religious matters
senses.definitionCN: 与日常的物质世界有关，而非与精神或宗教事务有关
senses.example: The monks still had to deal with mundane matters like food and shelter.
senses.exampleCN: 僧侣们仍得处理吃饭、住宿这类世俗事务。
senses.why: Latin mundus meant the world and was borrowed into church Latin as the earthly world in contrast to the heavenly one.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 mundus 原意是「世界」，在教会拉丁语里转指与天国相对的「尘世」，所以这个词首先指俗世而非灵界。

senses.title: Ordinary and everyday
senses.definition: ordinary and not special, happening or used in everyday life
senses.definitionCN: 普通而不特别的；日常生活中会出现的
senses.example: The filing of tax forms is a mundane part of running a business.
senses.exampleCN: 填税表是做生意中很平凡的一环。
senses.why: If the world is mundane, then the things of the world are plain everyday things, so the sense widens from the earth itself to the ordinary work done on it.
senses.whyCN: 既然世界是「尘世」，世上的东西便是普通的日常之物；于是词义从「尘世」自然扩展到尘世中的琐常事务。

senses.title: Dull and lacking excitement
senses.definition: boring because it is too ordinary and provides no interest or excitement
senses.definitionCN: 因为过于普通、毫无趣味而显得乏味
senses.example: His new novel is oddly mundane after the wild success of the first.
senses.exampleCN: 第一部大获成功之后，他的新小说却平淡得出奇。
senses.why: Being ordinary is one step from being dull, so the same word can express mild disappointment at a lack of spark.
senses.whyCN: 普通离乏味只差一步，因此同一个词也常用来表达对「缺少亮点」的轻微失望。

intro.en: Mundane comes from Latin mundanus, belonging to the world, from mundus, the world; the adjective in English first meant worldly or earthly.
intro.cn: mundane 来自拉丁语 mundanus（属于世界的），源于 mundus（世界）；英语中该形容词最初意为「世俗的、尘世的」。

items.en: Mundus names the world or the universe, and mundanus means belonging to the world.
items.cn: mundus 指世界或宇宙，mundanus 意为「属于世界的」。

items.en: Church Latin uses mundane things for the things of this world as opposed to holy ones.
items.cn: 晚期拉丁语用「尘世之物」指此世之物，与神圣之物相对。

items.en: The adjective pass over into French as mondain, of the world.
items.cn: 该形容词以 mondain 的形式进入法语，意为「世俗的」。

items.en: Mundane enters English with the same religious contrast between earthly and spiritual.
items.cn: mundane 进入英语时保留同样的宗教对比：尘世与精神。

items.en: In modern usage the word drifts toward the plain and the dull.
items.cn: 在现代用法中，这个词逐渐偏向「平淡、乏味」。

note.en: Mundane is the adjective of the world, close in form to mundanity and in meaning to ordinary and banal words.
note.cn: mundane 是表示「尘世」的形容词，形式上与 mundanity 同族，意义上与 ordinary、banal 一类词相邻。

entries.definition: the quality of being ordinary and dull
entries.definitionCN: 平凡；乏味

entries.definition: the world, in Latin
entries.definitionCN: 拉丁语「世界」，是这个词的直接词源

entries.definition: a pile of earth, or a low hill
entries.definitionCN: 土堆；小丘（只是拼写相近，词源不同）

entries.definition: normal and not special
entries.definitionCN: 普通的；平常的

entries.definition: dull because it is too familiar and predictable
entries.definitionCN: 陈腐的；老一套的

entries.definition: happening or used in normal daily life
entries.definitionCN: 日常的；每天的

normalIntro.en: Mundane is the adjective of the world: whatever belongs to the earthly world is mundane, and so later just plain.
normalIntro.cn: mundane 是「世界」的形容词：属于尘世的一切都是 mundane，后来便引申为「平平无奇」。

normal.en: Mundane tasks are the routine chores of daily life.
normal.cn: mundane tasks 就是日常的琐事。

normal.en: The noun mundanity means the dullness of everyday routine.
normal.cn: 名词 mundanity 指日常例行事务的平淡乏味。

normal.en: In religious writing, mundane matters stand against spiritual ones.
normal.cn: 在宗教文本中，mundane matters 与精神层面相对。

normal.en: Far from mundane means surprisingly unusual.
normal.cn: far from mundane 表示一点也不寻常。

normal.en: Compare banal: mundane is gently flat, banal is harshly tired and clichéd.
normal.cn: 对比 banal：mundane 的平淡是温和的，banal 则带有陈词滥调的贬义。

abstract.en: Picture monks in a temple still arguing about rent bills.
abstract.cn: 想象寺庙里的僧人也得讨论房租账单。

abstract.en: See a long desk stacked with forms and coffee cups.
abstract.cn: 想象一张长桌上堆满表格和咖啡杯。
